banner.unsaved: Not saved yet: this preview uses the values in the form.

destination.forum_thread: Posts in {{channel}} as a new thread "{{thread}}".
destination.reply: Replies to the signup post in {{channel}}.
destination.scheduled_event: Shows in the server's Events tab.

dialog.description: Preview of {{title}} as Discord will show it

gate.no_channel: Not sent: no announcement channel is selected.
gate.no_discord_server: Not sent: this organization has no Discord server linked.
gate.no_recipients: No one would be mentioned right now; nothing is sent.
gate.no_scheduled_event_yet: Not sent: the Discord scheduled event has not been created yet.
gate.no_signup_channel: Not sent: no signup channel is selected.
gate.no_signup_post_yet: Not sent: the signup post has not been posted yet.
gate.not_a_series: Not sent: only events in a series have subscribers.
gate.occurrence_collision: Not created: this time falls on one of the series' scheduled occurrences.
gate.series_ended: Not sent: the series has ended.
gate.series_paused: Not sent: the series is paused.
gate.start_in_past: Not sent: the event start time has passed.
gate.state_not_open_or_roll_call: Not sent now: this is only sent while signups are open or during roll call.
gate.state_not_signups_open: Not sent yet: this posts when signups open.
gate.toggle_off: Off: nothing is sent until you turn this on
gate.would_send: Ready: this is sent at its scheduled time.

note.dm_per_subscriber: Sent as a direct message to each series subscriber who has not signed up.
note.edits_refresh_embed_only: Later signup changes update this post's embed and buttons only.
note.existing_event_still_posts: The series makes no new events, but its existing upcoming event still posts.
note.fallback_drops_role_mentions: If posting in the signup channel fails, it is posted in the announcement channel without role mentions.
note.fallback_replaces_notice: With no signup post, the signup post goes to the announcement channel instead, and this announcement is not sent.
note.next_event_already_open_not_updated: The next event already has signups open, so it is not changed.
note.notice_falls_back_if_signup_post_fails: If the signup post fails, the signup post is posted here instead of this announcement.
note.shown_as_posted_when_signups_open: Shown as it will be posted when signups open.
note.signup_link_points_to_post: The "Sign up here!" link opens the signup post, which is created just before this notice.
note.signup_post_in_signup_channel: The signup post goes to the signup channel.
note.sync_overwrites_description: Syncing signups replaces the Discord event description with this text.
note.sync_keeps_created_name_and_time: Syncing signups changes only the description. Discord keeps the name and times the scheduled event was created with, shown here.
note.unsaved_links: Not saved yet: the event link opens the events list until you save.

start_mention.header_label: Header used when members are mentioned

status.needs_input: Fill in these fields to see a preview: {{fields}}
status.unavailable: Previews are available when creating or editing an event, which uses these defaults.

variant.current_post: The existing post, as it is updated now
